component.name: Amiga File Forge
component.summary: Open and maintain Amiga media images

description.p: Amiga File Forge browses, edits, validates and converts Amiga, Amiga 600, Amiga 4000 and AmigaOS disk, dms, ROM and hard-drive images.
The Linux application uses the same filesystem and editor implementation as the web edition, with a GTK file chooser, desktop file associations and private XDG working state.

A bundled architecture-native HxCFloppyEmulator command-line converter opens, creates and verifies supported HFE floppy images and decodes SCP flux captures without requiring a separate host installation.

Open OFS and FFS images can be converted between containers. Any of them exports as its canonical sector image, and OFS images together with FFS S, M and L floppies also export as HFE or SCP. Every flux export is decoded again and compared byte for byte with the working sectors before the file is released.

With the official Greaseweazle tools installed, the native edition writes an open floppy image to a connected drive and captures a physical disk back into a new working image, as decoded sectors or as HFE or SCP flux.

Adds installing a floppy onto a hard drive, by staging a multi-disc set, by installing WHDLoad, or by running the title's own installer under emulation. Reads LHA archives without an external decompressor.
Keeps the source disc's boot option when its files are installed into the root of an FFS image, so an installed disc still starts itself.
Adds SuperCard Pro flux support, container export, reading and writing real disks through a Greaseweazle or a floppy controller, and buildable Windows, macOS and RPM editions.
Restores reliable Linux application-menu and running-window icons with fixed-size fallbacks, explicit GTK identity and complete icon-cache refreshes.
Adds an About dialog with live application, host and filesystem-engine details, package links and licence information.
First stable release with shared web and native Linux workbenches, including bundled HxCFE support for HFE floppy images.
